latestTerminalSummary:
**Round 24 fails the target: three categories score 8.5 in both light and dark.** The report is at `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-24-opus-visual.md`; I wrote nothing else. The app was confirmed frozen (assets `bc0938a74a48`, no `internal`/`web` changes up to HEAD `3c797a16`).

| Category | Light | Dark |
|---|---:|---:|
| Typography | 8.5 | 8.5 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 8.5 | 8.5 |
| Component visual consistency | 8.5 | 8.5 |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |

**What holds the three categories down:** the editor's Network & permissions section, just under Tags, which no earlier round had compared against the shared form styles. I saw the same problems live at 1280 light and dark, 390 dark and 320 light:
- **Headings:** "Network allowlist" and "Capabilities" are 12px bold, while the rest of the form uses 13px labels and 14px section heads.
- **Capability names:** Downloads through Location are 16px plain text, larger than every other field label on the page.
- **Add button:** the allowlist Add is a filled primary button with no icon. The matching Add under Tags is an outline button with a plus. At 1280 it shows next to the filled "Create and add tag", so two filled buttons compete.
- **Empty allowlist:** on desktop the left column is about 260px of blank space, with no "nothing approved yet" line.
- **Smaller points:** at 320 the placeholder is cut mid-word ("https://exar"). When the section summary wraps to three lines, its chevron sits beside the middle line.

**What would earn a 9:** no ornament or new features are needed. Use the standard 13px label or 14px heading styles, turn the allowlist Add into the outline button with a plus, and add a one-line muted note for the empty list. Optionally, align the chevron to the first line and shorten the phone placeholder.

**Last round's three fixes are all confirmed live:**
- Tag-chip Edit/Remove buttons are 32×32 on desktop and 44×44 on phone.
- "Create and add tag" fills the column on phone (330px at 390).
- The Add property row is 44px throughout.

Share at 320×640 dark opens at the top with focus on Close, scrolls through to the bottom and keeps Done pinned. Stored-state actions, Find, Search with no results, Settings, the Add page and Library at 768 all look like 9-level work.

**Coverage limits:**
- Each width was seen in both schemes on at least one page, but I did not run every page in every combination.
- Not rechecked this round: Replace/Go/completion, the Edit tag sheet, Duplicate, the card menu and posture popup, Filters, the shared spaces, Versions, and Share at 390×640 and 640×360 landscape.
- Not exercised at all: long data, populated asset or allowlist rows, and enlarged text.
- Testing was in one Chromium engine with emulated sizes, not a physical phone.

I made no changes to data; the only input was a Find search I typed and then cleared. My preview tab is closed, and this one report doesn't establish a joint pass.
